dmp.description: DMP for the research project "Hybrid organic-inorganic nanocomposites and nanostructured materials for flexible X-ray detectors" (ERDF project No. 1.1.1.3/1/24/A/070), created to outline the general data management principles within the project. Project leader Dr. phys. Alexei Kuzmin. Project duration: 01.06.2025 - 31.05.2028. The total cost of the project is 656000.00 EUR (53% ISSP UL and 47% JSC Olaine Chemical Plant BIOLAR).
